notes: Manufacturer Kramer data sheet PDF (hosted via Markertek) confirms rear-panel layout: HDMI In, HDMI Out (with ARC), Balanced Stereo Analog audio on a 5-pin terminal block, S/PDIF on RCA, a DIP-switch/mute contact-closure block, and a 5V DC barrel power input. HDMI graded hdmi-2.0 since the datasheet states "4K@60Hz and ARC as specified in HDMI 2.0" and bandwidth up to 18Gbps. No rackUnits set - this is a compact desktop/surface-mount DigiTOOLS enclosure (4.72 x 2.81 x 0.96 in); Kramer offers an optional adapter to rack-mount 3 units side-by-side in 1U but the device itself is not natively rack-mountable. The front-panel mini/micro USB port is for firmware upgrade only (not used for signal I/O) and its USB version/speed is not published, so no grade was set. The 5-pin terminal block audio output is euroblock-style (closest available connector id); the list has no dedicated "balanced audio terminal block" id.

ports.name: HDMI Out
ports.note: Supports ARC (Audio Return Channel) as specified in HDMI 2.0

ports.name: Analog (Balanced Stereo Audio Out)
ports.note: 5-pin terminal block: L+, L-, GND, R+, R- balanced stereo analog audio de-embedded output

ports.name: 5V DC
ports.note: Power input from included 5.2V DC, 4A external power adapter; unit consumption 5V DC 370mA

ports.name: USB (firmware upgrade)
ports.note: Micro/mini USB port for local firmware upgrade only; not a signal/data host port, no speed grade published
